sprite.name: SCREAMING MANTIS
sprite.game: Metal Gear Solid4: Guns of the Patriots (2008, PS3)
sprite.incarnation: Screaming Mantis, forme Beast blindée de MGS4 PS3 (2008). Casque noir fermé à points jaunes, armure olive, rig dorsal cylindrique avec six bras mécaniques supplémentaires et lames courbes ; deux marionnettes distinctes, Psycho Mantis au masque à gaz et Sorrow sous capuche. Gala est une adaptation originale CQC : habit noir, gilet ivoire et nœud papillon, sans transformation en Beauty ni fusion avec Psycho Mantis MGS1. Les neutres et KO V2 rétablissent les rôles des marionnettes. Profil de combat existant : reconnaissance, préparation, mobilité, récupération et corps à corps ; aucune poupée projetée.

limits: Gala is an original CQC fan costume of the original MGS4 Beast incarnation, not a released canonical costume or absolute 1:1 certification.
Thirty independently drawn selected native keyposes, fifteen per direction; action phases share these keyposes rather than claiming a captured continuous animation cycle.

Both V2 directions are independently drawn disjoint native regions of one untouched PNG, declared by exact file, SHA256, face and rectangle. No direction is synthesized by mirroring or a duplicate directional PNG alias.
Canvas clip contours preserve alpha16 figure pixels while excluding neighbouring authored regions. The original weak alpha fringe and painted perspective remain qualified.
Original displayHeight245 and source standing scales232/297/526 are retained. Pelvic preview axes are independent of rig, blades and doll width.
KO pivots put the lowest authored body/rig/doll contact on the game floor; the source drawing includes painted depth between the fallen body and companion dolls.
Original PASS8 moves and physics remain unchanged. The legacy shoot/deploy action names animate recognition/preparation, not launched dolls or invented projectiles.
